name: Conanicut Yacht Club Junior Sailing
street_address: CYC Sailing Facility, 40 Bay View Drive
description_short: Junior sailing classes in Jamestown open to members and non members from age 8, from beginner dinghy sailing up to Optimist, ILCA and 420 racing teams.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations before June 1 are refunded minus a $35 fee; none after June 1.
notes: Open to non members, member guests, friends and relatives; non members pay a limited member fee of $120 per child for each two week session. Placement is by skill. First Mates program for ages 5 to 7. Sailors bring their own life jacket; no food is provided. Registration opens February 1 for members, February 15 for members' grandchildren and March 1 for everyone.
